units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite> <he>מה חטה זו סוֹפֶגֶת … סוֹפְגִין וכ׳</he> as the wheat (flour) absorbs (water), so Israel absorbs &c.
Ab. V, 15, v. סְפוֹג; a. e.—Trnsf. (cmp. לָקָה, בְּלַע) to receive lashes, be punished.
<cite ref="Mishnah Temurah 1:1">Tem. I, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>סוֹפֵג את הארבעים</he> receives forty (thirty-nine) lashes.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 4:3">Naz. IV, 3</cite> <he>אם אינה סופגת … תִּסְפּוֹג וכ׳</he> if she cannot receive the Biblical punishment, let her receive the punishment for rebellion; a. fr.
Sabb. XXII, 1 לא יִסְפּוֹג (Ar. יְסַפֵּג Pi.) he must not put down a sponge (to absorb the spilt wine).
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 6:5">Zeb. VI, 5</cite> <he>סְפָגוֹ במלח</he> he dried the dripping head of the sacrifice by rubbing salt on it.
<cite ref="Tosefta Zevahim 7:10">Tosef. ib. VII, 10</cite> <he>מלח ולא ס׳ ס׳ וכ׳</he> if he put salt on but did not dry it, or if he dried it without putting salt on; a. e.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 145a">Sabb. 145ᵃ</cite> <he>לסוֹפְגָן במלח</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לסופתן</he>, v. <cite ref="O01437"><he>סָפַת</he></cite>).—[<cite ref="Tosefta Zavim 1:9">Tosef. Zab. I, 9</cite> <he>וסופג</he>, read: <he>וסִפּוּג</he>.—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 840">Yalk. Deut. 840</cite> <he>סופגין</he>, read: <he>סופנין</he>, v. <cite ref="O01386"><he>סָפַן</he></cite>.]
Men. 7ᵇ וטבל ולא מַסְפִּיג (Rashi: מְסַפֵּג Pi.) he must dip (Lev. IV, 6) but not wipe, i.e. there must be blood enough in the vessel to dip the finger into it; Yalk. Lev. 469; Zeb. 93ᵇ מְסַפֵּג.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 17:2">Num. R. s. 17</cite> <he>נטלו והִסְפִּיגוֹ</he> he took it (the flayed ram) and wiped it (with salt, v. supra); a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>כשרף הזה … עד שמַסְפִּיגִין אותו</he> like resin which scarcely begins to ooze out, when arrangements are made to collect it; Tanḥ. B’midb. 16 (not <he>השבט</he>); ed. Bub. ib. 19; Yalk. Ezra 1067.

senses.gloss: to be wiped off, dried. Num. R. l. c. כאילו יצחק מִסְתַּפֵּג לפניך as if Isaac’s blood had been wiped off.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 22:5">Sabb. XXII, 5</cite> <he>הריחץ … ונ׳</he> if one bathed … and dried himself &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 22:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מִסְתַּפְּגִין וכ׳</he> wipe themselves with one sheet.
<cite ref="Tosefta Zavim 1:9">Tosef. Zab. I, 9</cite> <he>כדי … ויִסְתַּפֵּג</he> time enough for a person to bathe, come up and dry himself; a. fr.
